Tests dynamically import the component after stubbing NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY env, and install a window.google.maps stub (installGoogleMaps) that records map options, autocomplete calls, geocode calls, imageMapType options, placeFetchFields.
build_command: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and npm run lint (eslint .). Full 'npm run build' runs Next export + several generator scripts and is heavier; prefer typecheck+lint+test for verification. The live Google map will NOT render in sandbox because the browser key is referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/* - a blank map in sandbox is EXPECTED, not a failure.
test_command: npm run test (vitest run). Keep src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx green; update assertions as behavior changes.
verification_instructions: 1) npm install (if node_modules missing). 2) npm run typecheck. 3) npm run lint. 4) npm run test. All must pass. The component's honest-degradation path (no NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY -> no map, zero fetches) must remain intact - a dedicated test asserts zero fetch calls and absence of .vl-live-map-canvas when the key is unset.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant to this change. (Build has generator scripts for sitemap/blog-search/llms-txt but they are unrelated to VayuLokLive.)
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/wecare-digital && npm install. Work stays on git branch 'vayulok-retired-host-cleanup' (already checked out). Do NOT branch off 'stack'. Do NOT push or open PRs.
environment_constraints: Google Maps BROWSER key is referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/* so the live map, Places autocomplete, geocoding, and the weather/air/solar/pollen APIs only work on a deployed *.wecare.digital origin - never in CI/sandbox. Verification is via typecheck/lint/vitest + the honest-degradation path only. NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY must never be committed. No key literal may appear in any source file; the key is read ONLY from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY inside a useEffect/callback.
contribution_requirements: NO RED anywhere in the palette (owner constraint, see .agents/tasks/vayulok-home-aligned-mock/design-tokens.md + owner-constraints.md). AQI severity ramp walks dark green #1a3a2a -> satisfactory #3da35a -> lime #d1f470 -> poor #e8c547 -> worst #c98a2e; color is never the sole carrier (category word always printed). Google attribution must stay visible: NO CSS may target .gm-style-cc, a[href*="google"], or img[alt="Google"], and every overlay must stay inset from the map's bottom corners. Match the homepage design (src/pages/index.tsx styled-jsx + design-tokens.md): Inter font, lime #d1f470 fill + #1a3a2a type, control borders are #1a3a2a (NOT lime), hairline #e5e7eb (1px static/2px hoverable), radii only {14px panels, 999px/50px pills+CTAs, 10px/12px form fields}, single hover shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(26,58,42,.12), focus ring outline:3px solid #1a3a2a; outline-offset 2-3px.
key_patterns: VayuLokLive.tsx (~2900 lines) is ONE self-styled component with styled-jsx under a .vl-live- class scope. CRITICAL styled-jsx gotcha: styled-jsx only attaches its scoping class to markup it can statically SEE in the return tree - every element MUST stay INLINE in the return; lifting markup into a variable or child component silently drops all styles. The 'place card' the user means is .vl-live-map-preview (positioned absolute top:80px right:16px inside .vl-live-map-stage) containing a photo rail with the numeric 'pill' .vl-live-photo-count (currently renders '{n} photos'), place name, metrics, insight, and a 'View details'/'Jump to details' button. There is NO numbered pill in the left column (.vl-live-left is the stacked content). Map is built via the modern async loader + importLibrary('maps'|'marker'|'places'); constructors are imported, not read off google.maps global. Map options: gestureHandling:'greedy', disableDefaultUI:true, keyboardShortcuts:false, restriction {latLngBounds:INDIA_BOUNDS, strictBounds:true}. Search already uses the modern Places AutocompleteSuggestion.fetchAutocompleteSuggestions Data API with a per-session AutocompleteSessionToken, India-scoped (includedRegionCodes:['in'], region:'in', locationRestriction:INDIA_BOUNDS); geocoding is a fallback. Click on map reverse-geocodes to a mapCandidate and populates a preview.
